sn55.11:1.2: atha kho sahassabhikkhunīsaṅgho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhagavā etadavoca
sn55.11:2.1: catūhi kho bhikkhuniyo dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
sn55.11:2.3: idha bhikkhuniyo ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
sn55.11:2.4: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.11:2.7: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akkhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.11:2.8: imehi kho bhikkhuniyo catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
